$comment: Accepted pnpm audit advisories checked by scripts/check-audit.mjs (jotdown H0-8).
HIGH, CRITICAL and unknown-severity advisories fail CI unless listed here. Entry schema:
{ "id": "GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx" (GHSA id, numeric advisory id or CVE),
"package": "example-package" (npm package name, module_name in the report),
"justification": "Why the risk is acceptable and how it is mitigated." (non-empty),
"expires": "2026-12-31" (YYYY-MM-DD; after this date the exception fails CI),
Exceptions that match no current advisory are stale and fail CI, so remove them once the
dependency is upgraded. Keep this list empty unless an advisory cannot be fixed yet.
